# Landing Pass

Complete every item. This pull request is eligible for review only when all boxes are honestly checked.

## Clean-Artifact Law
- [ ] No notes-to-self, TODO, FIXME, TBD, or deferred-action markers in any file.
- [ ] No process narration, session chatter, or status-of-my-work.
- [ ] No hedges, unresolved questions, or "verify later".
- [ ] No placeholder or leftover drafting text.
- [ ] Every file reads as finished truth — it would appear, as-is, in a published technical document.

## Format
- [ ] One function = one folder.
- [ ] The function's required documents are present and complete (`00_GOVERNANCE/FUNCTION_FOLDER_TEMPLATE.md`).
- [ ] Naming and structure conform.

## Provenance and process
- [ ] Every claim is sourced.
- [ ] The function passed the Gauntlet.
